name: Amazon Best Sellers rank tracker → Google Sheets (daily chart history)

parameters.content:
## Amazon Best Sellers rank tracker → Google Sheets (daily chart history)
Every morning: pull the Amazon Best Sellers chart for a category, compare each product's rank with yesterday's, append the full chart to a Google Sheet (a growing rank history) and post new top-10 entries to Slack.

**Setup**
1. Credentials → **Header Auth** named `Apify Header Auth`: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <your Apify token>` (apify.com → Settings → API & Integrations). Select it in *Run Amazon charts*.
2. Edit `categories` (the slug after /gp/bestsellers/ in a Best Sellers URL, e.g. `electronics`, `kitchen`) and `domain` in *Run Amazon charts*. `pages: 2` gives the Top 100.
3. Connect Google Sheets in *Append to Google Sheets*. Sheet header row: date, category, chart, rank, previous_rank, change, asin, title, price, price_display, rating, ratings_count, url, first_run. Connect Slack in *Post to Slack* (or delete that node). The first run only seeds the history — Slack alerts start on day two.

Actor: https://apify.com/kestrel/amazon-best-sellers-scraper — $0.004 per product row, every rank filled (Amazon renders only 30 of a page's 50 entries; `fillRanks` fetches the rest). Top 50 = $0.20 per category per day, Top 100 (`pages: 2`) = $0.40. Status rows are free.
